answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on conditional lyrics generation. ... We propose a unified structure-aware lyrics generation framework named UniLG ...

answer_2.quote: We use three kinds of objective evaluation metrics: general level (Perplexity, Integrity), low level (Format F1, Beat F1), and high level (Structure F1).

answer_4.quote: For each subjective experiment, we invite 43 annotators to evaluate the generated lyrics. Each annotator is required to score lyrics concerning four aspects: Coherence, Fluency, Correlation, Fascination.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each generated lyric on four aspects: Coherence, Fluency, Correlation, Fascination using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
